requirements.requirement: The system must define a provider experience object schema containing fields: graduation_year, enumeration_date, derived_years_in_practice, and normalized_experience_score.
The system must represent graduation_year as an integer or null in the schema.
The system must represent enumeration_date as an ISO 8601 date string or null in the schema.
The system must represent derived_years_in_practice as a non-negative integer or null in the schema.
The system must represent normalized_experience_score as a numeric value between 0 and 1 inclusive or null in the schema.
The system must extend the provider detail response model to include the provider experience object as a top-level nested field.
The system must ensure the provider experience object is present in the response even when all fields are null.
The system must map enumeration_date from NPI data in provider_detail_service.py into the provider experience schema without transformation.
The system must allow graduation_year to be optionally populated from upstream data sources if available.
The system must maintain backward compatibility of the provider detail API by not removing or renaming existing fields.
The system must return null for derived_years_in_practice when both graduation_year and enumeration_date are missing.
The system must return null for normalized_experience_score when derived_years_in_practice is null.
The system must reject or sanitize invalid enumeration_date values that are not parseable as dates by setting the field to null.
The system must reject or sanitize invalid graduation_year values outside a reasonable range (e.g., less than 1900 or greater than current year) by setting the field to null.
